No new individual heat/material substitution, disposal fate, recovery credit, empty allocation or reverse mapping.
limitations: Reviewed Swiss waste-concrete inert-landfill reconstruction under the standing approval for complete matching-function/unit screening proxies. Preserve the as-received waste basis (0.5 kg water/kg), one kg generic inert-landfill operation, 1.48e-9 facility units and the original separate road and rail collection. Both component functions are generic cleanfill services; all nine operating land-use quantities and three facility land-use quantities match the inspected source. Facility capacity is 450000 m3 on both sides; no density, capacity, moisture or lifetime scaling is inferred. The complete native operating process has its own oil-boiler heat supply and waste-heat release, whereas the source uses mixed non-natural-gas heat with version-specific quantities. The native facility has different background material and freight supplies; source pitch-market supply includes a minor recycled-polyethylene-derived supplier as well as petroleum refinery production. Native use/aftercare durations are not explicitly documented. These supply, technology, vintage and life-cycle-detail differences are reported screening limitations, not LCIA equivalence. This does not authorize an individual heat or material substitution outside these complete services. Do not use the native building-waste recycling/crushing mix, add demolition, apply dry-mass scaling, add material-specific emissions absent from the source, or invent recovery credits. Retain the exact nonphysical waste indicator where supported; only an unavailable nonphysical indicator may be omitted with the already approved explicit warning. Preserve signed caller quantities, formulas, uncertainty and ownership. No physical-emission omission or reverse correspondence is inferred.
